data.long_meaning: The name Luvkush is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Luv' (love) and 'Kush' (prosperity). This name signifies a deep love that brings prosperity and abundance in one's life. The name Luvkush carries the meaning “Love and Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Luvkush usually hope their child will grow to embody love and prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
